title: The Story of a White Rocking Horse

The book primarily explores themes of friendship, adventure, and the emotional bond between children and their toys. After a whirlwind of fun, misadventures, and even a daring encounter with burglars, the rocking horse ultimately takes part in a joyful grass party, solidifying his place in Dick's loving home—a heartwarming exploration of childhood imagination and the joy of friendship among toys.
